{{Quote|The Rebellion has resisted more firmly than anticipated in the Farrfin and Dolomar sectors.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Farrfin sector''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Charmath]], [[Firro]], [[Phraetiss]], and [[Farrfin]] itself. The sector contained one of the Galaxy's most complete historical archives, in the [[University of Charmath]].

==History==
Both the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar]] and Farrfin sector were major targets of [[Thrawn campaign|offensives]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. The sectors were heavily defended by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] personally made a tour of the defenses in these areas.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]], [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]], [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss]], [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], and [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] in the Farrfin sector. Khomm is in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]; Bilbringi and Taanab are in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]; Kinyen is in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]; Byss and Rishi are in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. ''Rebellion'' and ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' also mistakenly spell the Farrfin sector as "Farfin sector."
